notes.title: Drastic in-game changes
notes.content:
Hello, okay with you guys? Today I come to announce drastic changes in LENDARIOS STORY BRIGHTNESS PART 1, starting with the name now the game will be called LENDARIOS: LIMITS BREAKERS 1, will have a whole saga being worked out gradually without haste, soon will be announced the cover of the game, in addition the game will contain a multiplayer mode of two players, a new story mode,  new bosses and many other new features.
The price of the game will be halved on the 30th of July, soon new cool news about the game. The Limits Breakers saga project is going to be a project where I'm hopeful, I hope I can count on your help giving opinions on what you would like to see in the game

notes.title: LENDARIOS STORY BRIGHTNESS PART 2
notes.content: LENDARIOS STORY BRIGHTNESS PART 2 will be released in DLC form but with a totally different mechanics from the LSBP1 version and in addition the game will also be available for Mobile, the DLC will come in November

notes.title: New Menu
notes.content: The home menu has changed and now comes with a new mode that will soon be unlocked

notes.title: May 9 Patch Details
notes.content:
Fixed a bug in the Nikko Archangel vs Nasu Archangel battle where the game crashed

Fixed a bug where the Brillonian King's ranged power in the Modified Goblin battle caused the game to crash

Fixing the bug where the game would not save in the start menu

New way to save the game within the mission, now you can save the game with the J key.

New way to exit the game when playing a mission, press the F key and then on the name EXIT

notes.title: Big update on May 9th
notes.content:
May 9 update what's next:
Fixes bugs where the game crashes in the Nikko Archangel vs Nasu Archangel battle
New 6 languages (there will be more languages in future updates)
Fix on the power of the Shining King in the fight against the Goblin Witch

What will come in the future?
An open world mode, where you can explore the Shining Kingdom with Nikko Sasaki, do quests, talk to NPCs, defeat monsters.
There will be a mode called Archangels vs Demons, which will tell the story of Nikko Archangel

notes.title: date of release
notes.content:
The game will be released on 05/04 and in the first week there will be a 40% discount.
There will also be a live from the game.
